pm_supplied_collateral_present.meaning: the Vault has supplied collateral under PM (via executeHedge()/supplyToBlp()) before settlement

pm_borrow_liability_present.meaning: PM auto-borrow / borrow-lend state has created a negative quote liability for the account before settlement

precompile_payload_has_borrow_and_supply.meaning: the 0x811 payload contains borrow.basis, borrow.value, supply.basis and supply.value for the token

usdc_moved_to_yieldescrow.meaning: settle() moved real USDC into YieldEscrow

assumptions: The PM supply and borrow-lend state described in the report is the state read by 0x811 at settlement time.
settle() is the action that would move USDC into YieldEscrow in the reported scenario.

unresolved.description: Report does not give numeric borrow.value/supply.value or a net-backing quantity, so the net-of-borrow backing relation cannot be expressed numerically; only the qualitative correspondence (no USDC moved to YieldEscrow when PM net state is negative) is encoded.
Report does not state whether the PM net state is actually negative in the concrete scenario, only that it can be ignored; the potential modality of the underlying scenario is not resolved.

limitations: Only the real_usdc_moved_into_yieldescrow impact is formalized; other listed impacts are handled in separate passes.
The backing/surplus numeric relation is represented qualitatively because no numeric operands are supplied.
Whether settle() and distributeYield() are separate transactions and their ordering is not modeled.
